name: test-file-unreferenced-declarations
description: A declaration of a test file that nothing references is reported under the code a production declaration of the same shape carries, and a test-file declaration only such a declaration references falls with it, while the test the runner calls is a root and is reported under no code. The helper nothing calls also calls a live production declaration, so it is no test of dead code. The production declarations the dead helpers reach stay out of the helpers' component: the live one is live through the command, and one only the unreferenced helper calls is reported under the test-only code as the root of a component of its own, the helper's call counting as a test reference.
